verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents 'Custom Agent Skills' and a developer guide for building them, implying an extensible skills system, but there is no evidence of a browsable public registry/marketplace or a one-click/one-command install flow — skill creation appears to require manual developer setup. missing for 10: a discoverable skills/plugins registry/marketplace UI, one-click or single-command install mechanism, and community or hands-on confirmation of browsing/installing skills this way.
